goal: Allow node operators to inspect completed or echoed private broadcast transactions via RPC
Preserves send history and echo reception details that were previously dropped upon completion
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now.
agreement: Concept approval because keeping completed transaction info is useful for users (optout21)
Fixes accepted for retry logic on un-echoed sends and preserving the first echo peer (frankomosh)
Open suggestion to add a test verifying echo peer data is not overwritten (frankomosh)
Discussion ongoing on whether to reset reception data when re-broadcasting (optout21, frankomosh)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it provides operational visibility for private broadcast users without affecting relay liveness.
The benefit is limited to inspecting finished private broadcast state via RPC.
